patch_description: This crossover retains the independently trainable RY and RZ rotations from the stronger compact inspiration, adds the current program’s ring closure, and preserves its noncommuting parity-shared RX mixer. Redundant RZ sandwiches and repeated CZ layers are removed because adjacent phase rotations commute with CZ gates, while duplicated CZ interactions can cancel. The resulting ring maintains global connectivity with substantially lower depth and gate count, uses only 18 parameters per repeated block, and should train faster with less overfitting while retaining useful expressivity.
